cpcb_stations.source: CPCB via CREA 'Tracing the Hazy Air 2026' (Jan 2026)

global_share_deaths.value: roughly a quarter to a third of the global PM2.5 death burden
global_share_deaths.note: India ~1.72M of the global total; not a majority — the earlier '70%' figure was incorrect

ncap_40pct_met.of: NCAP cities with sufficient PM10 data
ncap_40pct_met.note: CREA counts 102 NCAP cities with monitoring stations, of which 100 reported 80% or more PM10 data coverage. 23 of those met the revised 40% PM10 reduction target, 51 met the earlier 20-30% target, and 23 cities saw PM10 rise. The denominator is 100. It was briefly recorded as 96 by the 27 July 2026 fact-check round, which harmonised it with the site's own prior wrong text instead of checking the source; see docs/fact-check-2026-07-27.md, correction appended 17 September 2026.
